intro: Fel Moss is a tainted vegetative substance spreading through the forests of Teldrassil. Carrying demonic and corruptive energies, it is carried by hostile grell and grellkin and poses an insidious threat to the wildlife and native furbolg tribes of the World Tree.

p: Teldrassil was planted to restore the night elves' immortality and heal the natural world, but corruption has already crept into its pristine boughs. Fel Moss is one of the most visible signs of this degradation. Found clinging to and carried by the impish grells and grellkin infesting Shadowglen, this malevolent growth radiates an unnatural, wicked magic. Forest protectors like the dryad Tarindrella have begun gathering samples to measure just how deeply this rot has infiltrated the sacred woodland canopy.
